create.name: Michael Mayo
create.bio:
Michael Mayo is an American medium, astrologer and teacher of evidential mediumship. He trained for many years in Britain, sitting with mediums such as Gordon Smith of the School of Intuitive Studies and Eileen Davies of the Arthur Findlay College, and he grew up learning astrology from his family before going on to study psychology and drama at the University of California, Irvine. His readings aim to give clear, checkable details about a person in spirit before any message is passed on, and he teaches students to do the same.

He runs the Oakbridge Institute, an online school for mediumship and psychical study with progressive courses from foundations to working with the public, weekly practice circles and a student community. He also mentors developing mediums one to one or in small groups, holds traditional home circles for sitting in the power, and offers mediumship, psychic and astrology readings. His book Spirit Speaks, published by Llewellyn, sets out his step-by-step method: building a link with guides, recognising spirit people by their character, finding good evidence and handling the ethics of the work. He has taught in the United States, Europe and Australia.

books.title: Spirit Speaks: A Step-by-Step and Evidence-Based Approach to Genuine Spirit Communication
books.author: Michael Mayo
books.description: A practical guide to evidential mediumship, from sensing subtle energy and working with guides to recognising spirit people and finding solid evidence. It also covers the history and ethics of the work and common pitfalls.

courses.title: 1:1 Mediumship Mentoring (4 weeks)
courses.description: Four weekly one-hour sessions of individual guidance on your mediumship or psychic development. Practice circles at his school are included alongside.

courses.title: Mediumship Reading
courses.description: A reading in which he aims to connect with a loved one who has died, offering identifying details before any message. Booked through his site, with a waitlist when full.

courses.title: Psychic Reading
courses.description: A reading focused on your own path and circumstances rather than on contact with those who have died. He describes it as guidance for spiritual direction and development.

courses.title: Natal Chart Astrology Reading
courses.description: A consultation on your birth chart from a second-generation astrologer. It looks at strengths, patterns and themes in your life.

courses.title: Connecting with Your Guides Meditation
courses.description: A guided audio meditation for building a relationship with your spirit guides. Bought and downloaded from his site.

courses.title: 30 Minute Sitting in the Power Meditation
courses.description: A longer guided recording of sitting in the power, the traditional practice of resting in your own spirit that underpins mediumship training.
